metadata.title: About | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Learn about Sanskriti Kindergarten's early childhood philosophy, values, mission, and nurturing learning environment.

hero.subtitle: A sanctuary of early childhood excellence, where architectural grace meets a world-class curriculum.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose Sanskriti?
whyChoose.subtitle: Every detail is designed with intention — from the sunlit classrooms to the handcrafted curriculum.

features.title: Play-Based Learning
features.description: Learning through fun activities that boost creativity, curiosity, and a lifelong love of discovery.

features.title: Experienced Teachers
features.description: Caring and qualified staff who nurture every child with patience, empathy, and expert guidance.

features.title: Safe Environment
features.description: Secure campus with child-friendly infrastructure, CCTV monitoring, and thoughtful safety protocols.

features.title: Creative Activities
features.description: Art, music, dance, and imaginative play to develop holistic skills and self-expression.

items.label: Our Vision
items.content: To be the most trusted and beloved kindergarten, empowering children to become confident, compassionate, and creative learners for life.

items.label: Our Mission
items.content: We provide a warm, inclusive environment with a play-based curriculum that respects each child's unique pace of growth, fostering intellectual, social, and emotional development.

philosophy.description: At Sanskriti, we curate thoughtful early learning experiences where play, discovery, and social confidence grow naturally.

pillars.title: Safe Haven
pillars.description: A reassuring environment shaped by careful supervision, hygiene, and child-friendly routines.

pillars.title: Global Vision
pillars.description: Rooted in values while preparing children to think, express, and collaborate with confidence.

items.title: Compassion
items.description: We nurture kindness and empathy in every interaction.

items.title: Inclusivity
items.description: Celebrating diversity and welcoming every child equally.

items.title: Growth
items.description: Supporting steady development at each child's unique pace.

items.title: Excellence
items.description: Striving for the highest standards in everything we do.

items.title: Joy
items.description: Making learning a joyful and memorable experience.

items.title: Community
items.description: Building strong bonds between families, children, and educators.

quote.text: Our vision is to nurture a generation that is globally conscious, locally rooted, and eternally curious.
